errors.embeddings.unavailable: This build of Boba has no on-device model, so the semantic match (F3) is unavailable. Scoring works without it.
errors.embeddings.not_installed: The on-device model is not on this device. Turn on the semantic match in Settings → Scoring to download it.
errors.embeddings.download: The model could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
errors.embeddings.encode: The on-device model could not score this Offer. F3 is skipped for it; the other factors still count.
errors.embeddings.store: Boba could not save the semantic-match setting. Try again.
